Package index

Analysis workflow

The main steps, in the order they are run. See vignette("rhybphaser") for a worked example.

run_generate_consensus_sequences()
Generate Consensus Sequences
count_snps()
Count SNPs in Consensus Sequences
assess_dataset()
Assess HybPhaser dataset quality
generate_sequence_lists()
Generate sequence lists for loci and samples
generate_sequence_lists_after_assessment()
Generate Sequence Lists After Assessment
get_reference_samples()
Get Reference Samples from Consensus Sequence Files
extract_mapped_reads()
Extract Mapped Reads
run_clade_association()
Run BBSplit Clade Association
collate_bbsplit_results()
Collate BBSplit Results
run_phasing()
Run BBSplit Phasing
collate_phasing_stats()
Collate Phasing BBSplit Stats
run_phased_hybpiper()
Run HybPiper on Phased Read Files
make_phased_namelist()
Create Namelist from Phased Read Files
merge_sequence_lists()
Merge Phased and Non-phased Sequence Lists

merge_sequence_lists_from_config()
